integrity: Standalone checker and actual output embedded; proofs and spectral matrix specified; SHA-256 checks in private envelope.
scientific_limitations: Graph is on all odd elements including zero; characteristic odd, exactly four exterior generators. Finite-field checker corroborates only q=3,5,7. Priority against a more general projective incidence blow-up theorem is not exhaustively resolved.
title: An exact golden-band adjacency spectrum for the odd-part commuting graph of the four-generator exterior algebra
